profile.name: 串口文本行读取组件
profile.description: 非物理软件组件，用于通过串口持续读取按行组织的文本数据并进行缓冲，支持线程模式和非线程模式。适合在实验系统中接收外部串口设备输出的 ASCII 或行式测量数据。
profile.description_en: A non-physical software component for continuously reading line-based text data from a serial port and buffering it for use in threaded or non-threaded execution. It is suitable for receiving ASCII or other line-oriented measurement data from external serial devices in lab workflows.

registry.name: Open Standard Serial port connect/read/write
registry.description: Serial Line Reader是由Open Standard生产的实验执行&合成设备，主要功能包括停止、写入数据、启动、读取数据、运行。支持Signal, Slot, buffered等操作。
